mechanism.claim: Signed rejection wicks reveal whether failed intrabar excursions are being absorbed or overrun. Estimate that response law on the completed first seven hours, then apply it to independent final-hour wick pressure during elevated BTC variation.
mechanism.side: strict sign of first-seven-hour wick-to-next-body response times final-hour signed wick pressure
mechanism.why_distinct: HVWIR directly fades one aggregate dominant wick; HVSRP relates absolute returns to next returns; HVTLRR transfers turnover response and confirms block direction; HVIABR counts contemporaneous close locations. HVWRTR instead estimates an ordered signed-wick response law and applies it to a disjoint final-hour pressure sample without block-return confirmation.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the causal variation tail selects volatile paths while a response-tail gate selects stable rejection transmission
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: hourly onsets from lagged wick-response transfer are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.block: 96 exact coherent five-minute aggregates from 480 unique bars_binance BTCUSDT one-minute rows [D-8h,D)
features.response: sample Pearson correlation of signed_wick[t] with bar_return[t+1] for t=0..82; both sample variances positive and response strict nonzero
features.separation: bar 83 to 84 transition unused between response estimation and pressure application
features.final_hour_pressure: sum signed_wick[t] for t=84..95; finite strict nonzero
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared one-minute log(close/open) returns), finite strict positive
features.response_rank: strict-prior midrank of abs(response) over at most 2160 earlier source-valid hourly observations, minimum 1440, current excluded; rank>=0.80
features.eligible_state: response and variation gates pass with response and final-hour pressure strict nonzero
features.onset: eligible now and immediately preceding exact source-valid hour ineligible; missing prior cannot trigger

clock.decision: every exact UTC hour after the completed eight-hour block
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: ordered rejection-wick response transfer with disjoint application window

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no wick formula, response window, rank, side, hold, clock, subset, or control repair.
